TalentGate Sports Academy Management Platform

TalentGate is an integrated platform for managing and operating sports academies, bringing daily operations into one system that covers account and player management, category and schedule organization, event tracking, attendance, subscriptions, matches, evaluations, announcements, and reports. The requirement was to transform a multi-category, multi-model product offering into an organized digital experience where customers can select a product, model, and required quantity and submit a commercial inquiry, without introducing the pricing, payment, and shipping logic of a traditional e-commerce store.

Dawamatic is an integrated SaaS platform for companies to manage employees, geolocation-based attendance, shifts, requests, and basic payroll, providing employees and administrators with a unified and secure workflow through web and mobile applications.

Companies need to manage employee data, shifts, attendance, leave, permissions, payroll, and financial requests within a single operational cycle while ensuring attendance takes place at the correct location and time, reducing manipulation opportunities, and isolating each company’s data and permissions. Splitting these processes across spreadsheets, attendance tools, and multiple systems also makes it harder to review data, connect attendance with requests, payroll, and settlements, and maintain a reliable audit trail.

Dawamatic was built as a multi-company SaaS platform that combines HR, attendance, and workforce management in one centralized system. It provides company operations dashboards for managing employees, organizational structure, contracts, locations, shifts, attendance, requests, payroll, and financial operations, plus a mobile employee app for clock-in/out, schedules, requests, and payslips. Attendance is validated against geolocation, shift, device, and security policies, with suspicious-case review, corrections, and auditable history. The platform also connects leave, permissions, and overtime with attendance, Payroll Lite, advances, loans, claims, and offboarding, and includes a separate dashboard for Dawamatic platform administration, subscribed companies, plans, subscriptions, and operations.
